channel.title: Renux News
channel.description: The Renux Project news and announcements

item.title: Renux source now on GitHub
item.description: The complete Renux source tree is now mirrored at github.com/renuxproject/src.

item.title: Project website launched
item.description: The Renux project website is now live, with automatic theming, news and live commits.

item.title: amd64 baseline raised to x86-64-v2
item.description: The amd64 build now defaults to the x86-64-v2 baseline.

item.title: sched_renux becomes the default scheduler
item.description: The ULE-derived sched_renux scheduler is now the default in GENERIC.

item.title: RENUX_MALLOC enabled by default in GENERIC
item.description: The lock-free kern_malloc fork is now enabled by default.

item.title: FULL_PREEMPTION on by default
item.description: Full kernel preemption is enabled by default.

item.title: Aggressive VFS defaults land in GENERIC
item.description: renux_vfs_cluster and renux_vfs_subr deliver aggressive I/O defaults.
